title: rosa pimpinellifolia f. poteriifolia
intro: Rosa pimpinellifolia f. poteriifolia, commonly known as Chinese rose, is a type of rose species native to China, characterized by its fragrant flowers and edible hips. The health benefits of Rosa pimpinellifolia f. poteriifolia include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health, as well as its antioxidant properties that may help protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which may contribute to its use in traditional Chinese medicine. The bioactive constituents of Rosa pimpinellifolia f. poteriifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds that are responsible for its medicinal properties.
